messages.author: 027e86e2d7290ed1
messages.subject: Re: Rattle on Mac - Grey box then crash
parts:
I just went through this just last week.  You have done everything correctly.  The problem appears to be in the binaries of R for Mac, GTK ( from r.research.att), and cairoDevice.  They don't seem to link together correctly.  Several package authors are aware of the issue and are working to resolve.  There is no published time course of when this will happen.  Dr Verzani has had success in re-compiling all the source code (R, GTK, RGtk2, and cairoDevice) but that is well beyond my skill level.  The Rattle 'troubleshooting installation on Mac' speaks of using older versions of R and Rattle() in the meanwhile.

Bob Aronoff
